testcase.name: a region's own center point is within its own tile footprint
a region crossing the antimeridian still correctly includes a point just past 180 degrees
membership at a coarser zoom is at least as inclusive as at a finer zoom for the same point
a point a fraction of a degree from center, well inside a 10km radius, is within the footprint
a region crossing the antimeridian correctly excludes a point on the opposite side of the globe
a point just outside one region's footprint is still correctly excluded, not trivially true
a point far outside the region is not within its footprint
